title: TOEFL Mini Test: Structure and Reading
goals: menguji **Listening, Structure, Written Expression, dan Reading** sekaligus

lesson.text: Ini tes mini campuran dari unit TOEFL sebelumnya. Kerjakan tanpa membuka materi, lalu cek hasilnya. Untuk simulasi waktu, pakai **Mode ujian** di halaman level TOEFL.

lesson.title: Evaluasi setelah tes
lesson.text: Catat bagian dengan skor terendah dan ulangi unit yang bersangkutan: u157 (Listening), u158 (Structure), u159 (Written Expression), u160 (Reading).

items: Gunakan Mode ujian untuk simulasi waktu.

practice.q: Dengarkan. Apa yang tersirat dari pembicara kedua?
practice.say: Did you finish the paper? I wish I had started earlier.
options: She has not finished the paper
She does not need to write as usual
She started last week at the moment

practice.q: Dengarkan. Apa yang dimaksud pembicara kedua?
practice.say: The library closes at nine tonight. Then we had better hurry.

practice.q: Dengarkan. Di mana revolusi industri dimulai?
practice.say: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the eighteenth century. New machines made factories more productive, and many people moved from villages to cities for work.
practice.exp: Di Inggris. Jawaban yang tepat: **In Britain**.

practice.q: Dengarkan. Apa yang dihasilkan selain makanan?
practice.say: Today we will talk about photosynthesis. Plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make food. This process also produces oxygen, which animals need to breathe.

practice.q: Dengarkan. Apa topik ceramah?
practice.say: Today we will talk about photosynthesis. Plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make food. This process also produces oxygen, which animals need to breathe.

practice.q: Dengarkan. Bagaimana perasaan pembicara kedua?
practice.say: How did you do on the test? Not as well as I hoped.

practice.q: Dengarkan. Apa pendapat mereka tentang kuliah?
practice.say: I thought the lecture would never end. Me too. I almost fell asleep.
practice.exp: Membosankan. Jawaban yang tepat: **It was boring**.

practice.q: Dengarkan. Apa yang akan dilakukan pembicara kedua?
practice.say: Would you like to join us for dinner? I'd love to, but I have an exam tomorrow.

practice.q: Structure. Neither the teachers nor the principal ___ aware of the change.
Structure. The study of fossils, ___ paleontology, shows how life changed.
Structure. It is essential that every student ___ the form by Friday.
Structure. Not only ___ the exam, but she also won a scholarship.
Structure. ___ the city is large, it has no subway.
Structure. Scientists have discovered a new species ___ in the deep sea.
Structure. The Amazon is ___ than any other river in the world.
Structure. ___ the rain, the match continued.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The (A) number of students (B) are increasing (C) every year (D) in this city.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The teacher (A) asked us (B) to not (C) talk (D) during the test.
practice.exp: not to talk. Jawaban yang tepat: **(B) to not**.

practice.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: She (A) speaks (B) English (C) very good (D) now.
practice.exp: very well. Jawaban yang tepat: **(C) very good**.

practice.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: There (A) is (B) many (C) reasons (D) for this decision.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: He (A) suggested (B) me (C) to read (D) more books.
practice.exp: Suggested that I read / suggested reading.

practice.q: Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: She (A) has been (B) working here (C) from (D) 2015.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: (A) Despite of (B) the rain, (C) the match (D) continued.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The (A) children (B) was playing (C) in the (D) garden.

Teks: "The printing press, invented in the fifteenth century, transformed how information spread. Before it, books were copied by hand, which made them rare and expensive. After the press appeared, books became cheaper, and literacy rates rose steadily. As a result, new ideas about science and religion travelled quickly across Europe. Some historians argue that this change played an important role in the Renaissance."  ·  According to the passage, why were books expensive before the press?
options: Paper was rare at the moment
Few people could read this week
Taxes were high at the moment

practice.q: Teks: "Coral reefs are among the most diverse ecosystems on Earth, even though they cover less than one percent of the ocean floor. They protect coasts from storms, provide food for millions of people, and support a quarter of all marine species. However, rising ocean temperatures cause corals to lose the algae that give them colour and energy. This process, called bleaching, can kill an entire reef if the heat lasts too long. Scientists therefore urge governments to reduce carbon emissions, which warm the oceans."  ·  What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Coral reefs are valuable but threatened by warming oceans
Coral reefs cover most of the ocean

quiz.q: Structure. ___ was found in the cave surprised the researchers.
Structure. ___ have shown that sleep improves memory.
Structure. Researchers have found that people ___ outdoors tend to feel happier.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: The (A) price (B) of the tickets (C) have (D) increased.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: (A) During I was (B) walking, I (C) saw (D) an accident.
Written Expression. Pilih bagian yang salah: It is (A) important that he (B) arrives (C) on time (D) tomorrow.
